static_candidate_subject.meaning: Declared committed implementation snapshot for a static schema/graph test; not the current dirty filesystem and not live Prime/Git admission

identities.build_B: Independent byte-identity witness only; no fallback or alternate launch

historical_result.rule: Fresh admission may establish present facts but cannot repair or imply the missing historical observation

source_admission.scope: Exact saved 13-file static implementation, not the whole Prime tree
source_admission.path_resolution: Descriptor-rooted component walk and held parent/leaf joins; reject symlink components and group/other-writable ancestry
source_admission.uid_rule: Each source/image owner must equal the bootstrap effective UID; record GID rather than assuming a fixed group
source_admission.hashing: pread from offset0 without changing an input cursor; fstat before and after; all captured fields stable
source_admission.boundary_comparison: Full metadata and byte comparison before EVERY stage and after EVERY reap; a bytes-only check cannot mint the admission token
source_admission.prime_identity_scope: The 2c25246d source identity is an inherited committed subject pin, not a new live Prime closure or dirty-worktree hash

image_admission.holding: Hold read-only descriptors and parent descriptors through the entire bootstrap; compare to saved device/inode/size/mode/nlink/hash plus Mach-O UUID/architecture/build-version
image_admission.mode_rule: 0755 executable files inside the retained private Build A root; do not chmod, copy, strip, sign, relink or replace images
image_admission.Mach_O_reading: Parse bounded held bytes with explicit endian/offset checks; no analyzer subprocesses during the future bootstrap
image_admission.spawn_identity_limit: Ordinary named-path posix_spawn is only pre/post descriptor-and-name detection. No suspended mapped-image join, no mapped vnode authority, no claim that holding a descriptor eliminates the exec-path race

registry.scope: Admit as one of the13 source files. Existing workers still enforce compiled literals; this control does not retrofit registry admission into them.

inputs.embedding: Two separately frozen immutable decoded byte arrays inside the future Swift bootstrap. Do not derive CBOR from JSON output, import either authority, or invoke a product to create its own input.
inputs.hex_carrier: Lowercase hexadecimal ASCII plus exactly one LF; the LF is carrier framing and is NOT part of the decoded input

expected_semantic_root.preimage: ASCII ERGENTICS-GATE-E-STATIC-SEMANTIC-V1, one00 byte, UInt64BE1405, exact JSON candidate bytes
expected_semantic_root.scope: Expected mathematical commitment to exact declared subject/roles/predicates/prestate; not an observed execution receipt

native_transport.form: New standalone excluded Swift executable with a tiny in-image fixed-arity C target
native_transport.bootstrap_entry: Zero arguments; empty replacement environment; no CLI language, env protocol, path/config/request loader, or caller-selected role
native_transport.imports: Neither authority target, join target, PrimeCore nor dirty StartOwner may be imported
unchanged: All three existing product sources and binaries
Production Driver V2 supervisor main and DriverCore
Existing StartOwner/Ruby drafts and historical records
native_transport.C_surface: Fixed-arity descriptor creation/read/stat/write/sync/close, clock, SIGCHLD configuration, three distinct fixed spawn entry points, exact-PID wait, and one fixed SIGKILL entry point. Private implementation helpers may share mechanics; no exported argv/env/path-command executor.
native_transport.spawn_inputs: C spawn entry points receive only already-owned descriptor slots and an out-result. Executable path, argv0, empty env and flags are compiled constants for each fixed stage.
native_transport.spawn_result_rule: Return spawn-entry/return/PID and teardown statuses separately. On successful spawn, ownership of the exact PID must be captured before any fallible post-spawn operation; teardown errors cannot discard a live PID.

endpoint_invariants.inputs: Separate read-only regular-file open descriptions, exact held vnode/hash/size, offset0 and finite EOF. pread for parent reads. Duplication for FD parking may share only an as-yet-unconsumed role-local description; never use dup of a previously consumed description as a fresh cursor.
endpoint_invariants.outputs: Distinct exclusive no-replace regular files mode0600, initially zero bytes, no input/output or output/output inode aliases. Separate stderr file; no pipe chain.
endpoint_invariants.join_readmission: Only after both projectors are exactly reaped and all outputs checked: sync captures, close writer handles, independently open read-only descriptions and join them to captured vnodes/hashes before JOIN
endpoint_invariants.cwd: Held empty workspace subdirectory, passed by posix_spawn fchdir action; never source, image, evidence or candidate directory. Check still empty after each reap.
endpoint_invariants.cap_limit: Post-read/acceptance bounds, not kernel-enforced filesystem quotas; fixed inputs and admitted closed images bound normal output structurally

next_requires: Current stage normal exit0 and exactPID reaped
Complete expected outputs and stderr exactly empty
Full current source/image/endpoint metadata AND bytes admission complete
ordering.type_requirement: A private immutable FullBoundaryAdmission token must contain the entire checked cut. Only its stage-specific one-shot consumer can reach the corresponding fixed C spawn. No public constructor or partial/boolean observation can stand in for this token.
ordering.reject: Any failure forbids later stages and retries. Partial verifier output never counts as stage completion.

receipt_binding.graphs: JSON and CBOR graph capture bytes must be identical; hash the actual held bytes. Both reconstructed_graph_frame_sha256 values and verifier graph_frame_sha256 values equal that actual hash.
receipt_binding.semantic_root: Every verifier/roundtrip/join semantic field must equal expected_semantic_root093b6e90. The join independently recomputes this root from the graph source witness, roles, predicates and00000000/ABSTAIN prestate; this binds the exact external subject without treating lowerhex syntax as identity.
receipt_binding.merkle_root: All verifier/roundtrip/join graph_merkle_root fields agree; JOIN independently recomputes all13 row identities and the Merkle tree.
receipt_binding.output_join: FD8 capture bytes equal BOTH admitted projector graphs; join receipt references their actual SHA256 and the same semantic/Merkle roots.
receipt_binding.parser: Use closed exact canonical receipt grammars: fixed key order, exact schemas/authority labels/PASS literals, lowercase64hex fields, no whitespace/LF/escaping/duplicates/unknown fields. No regex substring scraping or general command/data loader. Bootstrap must never generate worker graph/verifier/roundtrip/join output bytes.
receipt_binding.static_transition: CANDIDATE_SCHEMA_ROLE_PREDICATE_AND_PRESTATE_EXACT only; the16 GateE role names are data, not process entries.

future_deadline_and_reap_policy.approval_required: A later exact launch approval must cover up to3 fixed direct children and at most1 positive-PID SIGKILL per still-owned unreaped child; no signal authority is derived from this design.
future_deadline_and_reap_policy.timebase: mach_continuous_time and mach_timebase_info captured before spawn; numerator and denominator nonzero
future_deadline_and_reap_policy.deadline_predicate: UInt128(now_tick-start_tick)*numerator >= UInt128(5000000000)*denominator; checked subtraction/conversion. Record raw ticks and rational timebase, not rounded nanoseconds.
future_deadline_and_reap_policy.polling_limit: Observation cadence only, not a hard real-time completion bound
future_deadline_and_reap_policy.parent_reaper: Before first child explicitly set SIGCHLD SIG_DFL with SA_NOCLDWAIT cleared. One serial sole reaper; no wait-any or competing waiter.

wait_transitions.waitpid==exactPID: Atomically mark REAPED; later signal forbidden
wait_transitions.EINTR: Preserve slot and recheck deadline; no new child
wait_transitions.ECHILD_or_unexpected_PID: OWNERSHIP_LOST; no signal and no conservation inference

future_deadline_and_reap_policy.deadline_action: Only while OWNED_UNREAPED: consume the one in-memory KILL commitment before entering kill(exactPositivePID,SIGKILL); capture raw return/errno and never retry that signal, including EINTR/ESRCH. Then wait only for exact reap.
future_deadline_and_reap_policy.PID_safety_basis: Under the exclusive-reaper/no-auto-reap invariant, a child that exits between polling and KILL remains a zombie with its PID reserved. This does not establish arbitrary-PID or process-group safety.
future_deadline_and_reap_policy.reap_residual: Kernel-blocked reap may remain nonterminal indefinitely. ECHILD is ownership loss, not successful containment. No process-group-empty or descendant conservation authority is claimed.

retention.root_creation: Exclusive absent-to-present creation only under a held fixed parent, mode0700, current effectiveUID. Record actualGID; no assumed group0. Root must be disjoint from both retained builds, original drafts and Prime/companion roots.
retention.file_create: Fixed-arity C openat with O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC and mode0600; no replacement, truncation of old leaves or cleanup
retention.record_rule: Separate bounded canonical observation leaves; no self digest. Every successor records exact previous record byte SHA256. Sync required records before advancing; preserve raw call results and all partial outputs.
retention.start_semantics: Declared future budgets are not entered-call observations. Missing terminal is incomplete, never evidence of zero calls or permission to rerun.
retention.post_spawn_record_failure: Keep exact child ownership. Predeclared approved disposal budget may contain the owned child even if later recording fails; do not infer a complete durable call receipt. No successor stage. Actual launch control must bind this residual explicitly.
retention.product_scope: Workers write only inherited capture FDs by source design; not kernel filesystem confinement. Do not claim archival release truth or power-loss proof beyond checked sync outcomes.

implementation_verification.next_source_slice: Implement only the six native-bootstrap paths, embed these two frozen wire buffers, and add pure state/receipt/FD-plan tests. No live child test by inference.

scope.live_E_requires: Separately admitted dedicated supervisor and all16 fixed Git/Swift roles, independent DriverCore reparse/live bind and retained-lifetime continuity; this static control cannot produce11110000

digest_rule: This control carries no self digest. Hash its complete bytes externally and bind its selective Git commit/tree. Input-carrier digests address carrier bytes; decoded-wire digests address the actual future input bytes.
